metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over Brooklyn, New York lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 ("COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2") - Date: Oct 1-23 for years 2018, 2019, and 2021 - Location: Brooklyn, New York (approximate center: -73.95, 40.65) - Band: "tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density" or "NO2_column_number_density" 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-5P has a quality flag (qa_value). Should filter for qa_value > 0.75 or 0.5 for good data - The question is about NO2 concentration, not clouds, so mask poor quality data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Mean NO2 could legitimately be very low (near 0) if air quality improved - C1: If no images found for any period - C2: If images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or values are unrealistic (negative NO2) - A: If 2021 < both 2018 AND 2019 - B: Otherwise ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions brooklyn = ee.Geometry.Point([-73.95, 40.65]).buffer(10000) # 10km buffer around Brooklyn center # 2. Data Acquisition collection_id = "COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2" # Quality mask function def mask_no2(image): qa = image.select('qa_value') mask = qa.gte(0.5) return image.updateMask(mask) # Get data for three periods col_2018 = ee.ImageCollection(collection_id) \ .filterBounds(brooklyn) \ .filterDate('2018-10-01', '2018-10-24') \ .map(mask_no2) col_2019 = ee.ImageCollection(collection_id) \ .filterBounds(brooklyn) \ .filterDate('2019-10-01', '2019-10-24') \ .map(mask_no2) col_2021 = ee.ImageCollection(collection_id) \ .filterBounds(brooklyn) \ .filterDate('2021-10-01', '2021-10-24') \ .map(mask_no2) # Check collection sizes size_2018 = col_2018.size().getInfo() size_2019 = col_2019.size().getInfo() size_2021 = col_2021.size().getInfo() print(f"Images found - 2018: {size_2018}, 2019: {size_2019}, 2021: {size_2021}") if size_2018 == 0 or size_2019 == 0 or size_2021 == 0: print("Missing data for one or more years.") print("C1") else: # 3. data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
brooklyn = ee.Geometry.Point([-73.95, 40.65]).buffer(10000)  # 10km buffer around Brooklyn center

# 2. Data Acquisition
collection_id = "COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2"

# Quality mask function
def mask_no2(image):
    qa = image.select('qa_value')
    mask = qa.gte(0.5)
    return image.updateMask(mask)

# Get data for three periods
col_2018 = ee.ImageCollection(collection_id) \
    .filterBounds(brooklyn) \
    .filterDate('2018-10-01', '2018-10-24') \
    .map(mask_no2)

col_2019 = ee.ImageCollection(collection_id) \
    .filterBounds(brooklyn) \
    .filterDate('2019-10-01', '2019-10-24') \
    .map(mask_no2)

col_2021 = ee.ImageCollection(collection_id) \
    .filterBounds(brooklyn) \
    .filterDate('2021-10-01', '2021-10-24') \
    .map(mask_no2)

# Check collection sizes
size_2018 = col_2018.size().getInfo()
size_2019 = col_2019.size().getInfo()
size_2021 = col_2021.size().getInfo()

print(f"Images found - 2018: {size_2018}, 2019: {size_2019}, 2021: {size_2021}")

if size_2018 == 0 or size_2019 == 0 or size_2021 == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or more years.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Calculate mean NO2 for each period
    band = 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'
    
    mean_2018_img = col_2018.select(band).mean()
    mean_2019_img = col_2019.select(band).mean()
    mean_2021_img = col_2021.select(band).mean()
    
    # Check pixel counts
    count_2018 = mean_2018_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=brooklyn,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(band).getInfo()
    
    count_2019 = mean_2019_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=brooklyn,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(band).getInfo()
    
    count_2021 = mean_2021_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=brooklyn,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(band).getInfo()
    
    print(f"Valid pixels - 2018: {count_2018}, 2019: {count_2019}, 2021: {count_2021}")
    
    if count_2018 == 0 or count_2019 == 0 or count_2021 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after masking for one or more years.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # Calculate mean values
        mean_2018 = mean_2018_img.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=brooklyn,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get(band).getInfo()
        
        mean_2019 = mean_2019_img.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=brooklyn,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get(band).getInfo()
        
        mean_2021 = mean_2021_img.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=brooklyn,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get(band).getInfo()
        
        print(f"Mean NO2 (mol/m^2) - 2018: {mean_2018:.6e}, 2019: {mean_2019:.6e}, 2021: {mean_2021:.6e}")
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        if mean_2018 is None or mean_2019 is None or mean_2021 is None:
            print("Calculation returned None.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif mean_2018 < 0 or mean_2019 < 0 or mean_2021 < 0:
            print("Invalid negative NO2 values.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            # Check if 2021 is lower than both 2018 AND 2019
            if mean_2021 < mean_2018 and mean_2021 < mean_2019:
                print("2021 NO2 concentration was lower than both 2018 and 2019.")
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("2021 NO2 concentration was NOT lower than both 2018 and 2019.")
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
